title: Sindh Local Government Fourth Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Fourth Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XII OF 2010
ACT XII OF 2010
SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT
(FOURTH
AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act further to amend the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh
Extraordinary, Part IV,
24th June, 2010]
No.PAS/Legis-B-9/2010, dated 24-6-2010.---The Sindh Local Government (Fourth Amendment) Bill, 2010 having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on
5th June, 2010 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 20th June, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the Sindh Local
Government Ordinance, 2001, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Sindh Local Government
(Fourth Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

on 20th June, 2010 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the Sindh Local
Government Ordinance, 2001, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment in section 179-A of Sindh Ordinance No.XXVII of 2001.--In
the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001, in
section 179-A, in subsection (5)---
(i) in
clause (a), for the words "seventy five days", the words "six
months" shall be substituted.
(ii) in clause (b), for the
figure and words "165 days", the words "nine months" shall
be substituted.
